description: Historical price trajectory, pool liquidity, and reserve metrics of a subnet's alpha token via Taostats v1 Subnet Pools History API. Requires TAOSTATS_API_KEY. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_tao_alpha_prices when you need alpha token spot price in TAO, pool liquidity, and reserve; crypto_tao_subnet_yield_history when you need validator staking yield and APY breakdown for a specific. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
